Price remains significantly below the 100-day/200-day moving averages, suggesting lingering downside pressure. Weekly RSI is approaching oversold territory at 32.6. ADX at 27.9 indicates a trend, but with +DI at 14.6 and -DI at 24.1, downside pressure is dominant.
